# eon_backup_posture_control (Resource)

Manages a backup posture control: the backup requirements a set of resources must satisfy, and the severity of the violations raised when they do not. `resource_selector` picks the resources the control applies to, `rules` states the requirements. A rule you omit is not enforced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: production resources tagged team=core must keep 30 days of daily backups,
# in at least two copies, one of them in another region.
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "production_3_2_1" {
  name     = "Production 3-2-1"
  severity = "HIGH"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "CONDITIONAL"

    expression = {
      group = {
        operator = "AND"
        operands = [
          {
            environment = {
              operator     = "IN"
              environments = ["PROD"]
            }
          },
          {
            tag_key_values = {
              operator = "CONTAINS_ANY_OF"
              tag_key_values = [{
                key   = "team"
                value = "core"
              }]
            }
          },
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  rules = {
    minimum_retention = [{
      frequency         = "DAILY"
      minimum_retention = 30
    }]

    number_of_copies = {
      min_copies = 2
    }

    cross_region = true
  }
}

# Example: every resource must keep at least one backup copy, retained no longer than a year.
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "max_retention" {
  name     = "Retention ceiling"
  severity = "LOW"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "ALL"
  }

  rules = {
    maximum_retention = {
      maximum_retention = 365
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the control.
- `resource_selector` (Attributes) Determines which resources this control applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector))
- `rules` (Attributes) The backup requirements a matching resource must satisfy. Every rule is optional: a rule you set is evaluated, a rule you omit is not enforced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned to violations of this control. Supported values: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the control.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_selector`

Required:

- `resource_selection_mode` (String) How the control selects resources. Supported values: `ALL`, `NONE`, `CONDITIONAL`. `CONDITIONAL` requires `expression`.

Optional:

- `expression` (Attributes) Condition selecting the resources this control applies to. Set exactly one attribute; use `group` to combine conditions with `AND`/`OR`. Required when `resource_selection_mode` is `CONDITIONAL`, ignored otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector--expression))

<a id="nestedatt--resource_selector--expression--vpc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_selector.expression.vpc`

Required:

- `operator` (String) Operator. Supported values: `IN`, `NOT_IN`.
- `vpcs` (List of String) Values to match.




<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `cross_account` (Boolean) Whether at least one backup copy must be stored in a different cloud account.
- `cross_cloud_provider` (Boolean) Whether at least one backup copy must be stored in a different cloud provider.
- `cross_region` (Boolean) Whether at least one backup copy must be stored in a different region.
- `maximum_retention` (Attributes) Maximum retention a backup may keep before it is considered non-compliant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--maximum_retention))
- `minimum_retention` (Attributes List) Minimum retention required per backup frequency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--minimum_retention))
- `number_of_copies` (Attributes) Minimum number of backup copies that must exist. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--number_of_copies))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--maximum_retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.maximum_retention`

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--rules--minimum_retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.minimum_retention`

Required:

- `frequency` (String) The backup cadence this minimum retention applies to. Supported values: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`, `ANNUAL`.
- `minimum_retention` (Number) The minimum backup retention period, in days.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--number_of_copies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.number_of_copies`
